headline: 'Will reach 1 million won' 'This is a super special sale': the whole nation was in a frenzy, but the 'national portal' is struggling. What happened?
summary: Naver, a Korean internet blue-chip, has seen sluggish share price performance despite record-high earnings. The report examines why the stock has underperformed.
why: Naver is South Korea's largest internet platform operator, with exposure to search, commerce and fintech, so its share price is a bellwether for the Korean tech sector.

impacts.name: Naver
impacts.why: The report says the share price has been sluggish despite record-high earnings.
